title: Device
description: Where the model runs: the Hexagon NPU, the Adreno GPU, the CPU, or NPU and GPU together (hybrid). Model default takes the device the model was downloaded for. AI Hub bundles run on the NPU only. Applies from the next model load.

title: Context Length
description: Maximum prompt plus reply length in tokens. 0 takes the model's own length; a larger value is cut to what the model allows. Applies from the next model load.

title: NPU Power Mode
description: How hard the NPU is driven. Burst is Qualcomm's default and the fastest; the saver modes trade speed for battery. Ignored on the GPU and the CPU. Applies from the next model load.

title: Timeout for GenieX
description: How long a GenieX model may take to load, in seconds: opening the file, creating the model on its device (the NPU compiles on the first run) and starting the host's server.
